each_value_needs_astra.basis_rows: the three orthonormal axis vectors have no authored value and cannot be reconstructed from child frames without assuming alignment
each_value_needs_astra.coordinate_unit: the frame's length unit must be authored — the adapter reads meta.units as evidence only and will not assume metres
each_value_needs_astra.handedness: the frame chirality must be authored; handedness in meta is convention, not a pose constraint on the root basis rows
each_value_needs_astra.origin_m: the root origin has no authored value; deriving it from a child fitted_origin would be an alignment the adapter refuses to invent
each_value_needs_astra.parent_frame_id=null: the assembly root must declare exactly one null parent; no segment in the packet does, so this is an authored decision rather than a derived one
each_value_needs_astra.scale_to_m: a non-unity scale rescales every child frame, so it must be explicitly authored rather than inferred from the children's fitted scales

why_not_derivable: no segment declares parent_frame_id null and the packet's segment tree is a forest of disconnected components; every referenced-but-unsegmented parent is a dangling root, so no authored transform places any frame at an assembly root. The child segments' fitted_origin/frame_basis are relative to their own parents, not to a root. This adapter will not insert an identity transform or infer the root pose from them.
